title: Bulgur wheat salad with prawns, cucumber and mint
blurb: A light grain salad with tender prawns, fresh mint and crisp cucumber on a bed of baby spinach.
steps: Put the bulgur wheat in a heatproof bowl and pour over 200ml boiling water with a pinch of salt. Cover and leave to stand for 10 minutes until the water is absorbed and the grains are tender.
While the bulgur soaks, halve the cucumber lengthways and scoop out the seeds with a teaspoon, then slice into half-moons. Roughly chop the mint leaves.
Fluff the cooked bulgur with a fork and spread it out on a plate to cool for a minute or two.
Squeeze the lemon juice into a large bowl and whisk in the olive oil with some salt and pepper.
Add the bulgur, prawns, cucumber, spinach and mint to the bowl and toss everything together gently.
Divide between two plates and serve straight away.
